description: This file defines a Dialog API for Drupal, including a class for dialog events, default dialog settings, and a polyfill for HTML5 dialog element using jQueryUI. It manages dialog behaviors such as opening, closing, and event dispatching, with support for modal dialogs and body scroll locking.

classes.name: DrupalDialogEvent
classes.description: Custom event class for dialog-related events, extending the standard Event class with dialog-specific properties.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Default close method in dialog options, which closes the dialog and detaches behaviors.

methods.name: Drupal.dialog
methods.description: Main function to create and manage dialog instances, supporting open, show, showModal, and close operations.
